title: Electricity Network Operator
summary: Adds a new Network Delivery & Maintenance capability — capital construction, planned maintenance, field workforce, streetworks, wayleaves, vegetation and contractor management — to v2's network-operator capabilities. Pending review.
sourceDescription: Starter capability map for an electricity network operator, v3: adds a new level-1 capability, Network Delivery & Maintenance (S1 item 14), covering the delivery/field side of running the network — capital projects and construction, planned maintenance and inspection, field workforce scheduling and dispatch, streetworks and permits, land/wayleaves/consents, vegetation management and contractor management — as its own grouping rather than folding it into Asset Management (which stays about knowing and planning the asset base, not executing work on it). Judgement call made while drafting: v2's own `9.6 Vegetation Management` is removed here and replaced by `13.6 Vegetation Management` under the new level-1 — the same capability, relocated to the grouping this item explicitly names it under, rather than left duplicated in both places (v2 was never published, so nothing seeded from it depends on code `9.6`). Codes 1-8 and every other 9-12 item are unchanged from v2. Drafted from the same sources as v1/v2 (sources.md); nothing copied verbatim. Pending human review.
